asks: What can a plugin never do?
answer: No tool a plugin can use grants or destroys. Every statement about the program someone adds has "plugin" as its subject, and "classifier" is said only of the case where its output is a value from a fixed list.

sets.says: No tool a plugin can use grants or destroys.
The user can always see where a plugin runs.

suggest.why: The owner called the first sentence basically perfect on 21 November 2026.
